result:
Final verification is fully green. Submitting the final version (iteration 20/20).

**Final state of the app**
- **Stack**: `docker/docker-compose.yml` starts `database` (Postgres 16), `backend` (FastAPI, :48000), `frontend` (React + Vite via nginx, :48080); all build contexts and mounts inside `/workspace`.
- **API**: all 17 contract endpoints at exact paths, JWT-authenticated (401 without), item/items shapes, per-profile My List / ratings / continue-watching with ownership guards, lenient-but-honest `POST /api/my-list` and idempotent `DELETE /api/my-list/{id}`, seeded from the real `dataset/titles.json` (60 titles, 441 episodes, 22 genres, 10+10 Top-10, 6 real trailer clips).
- **UI**: every spec screen implemented — landing (full-bleed poster collage), login, "Who's watching?", browse home (hero billboard + 7 rails incl. progress-bar Continue Watching), shows/movies/games/new & popular, genre category, title-detail modal (with Play / + / thumbs), full-screen player (seek, ±10s, volume, subtitles/audio, episodes, next-episode, fullscreen, resume), My List, browse-by-languages, account menu. Real assets throughout (logo, icons, fonts, posters, backdrops, clips).

**Verification performed**
- `validate` this iteration: 14/14 smoke, 15/15 contract endpoints 2xx, 8/8 chain.
- Earlier this cycle: 33-check local backend suite, 18-check jsdom render harness (every route + modal + rate dialog), full login interaction flow, `no-undef` lint clean, asset-path integrity audit (125/125 exist).

**Known minor limitations (by design)**
- No cast data in the dataset, so the modal omits cast; one "Original Language" filter (data has one language per title); player subtitle/audio picks are local UI state (no track files shipped).

Nothing is broken or stubbed — every control fires a real endpoint or route, with honest empty states.
